text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Health certificate (within 6 month). * 2. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. * 3. High School Diploma The documents in other language except Chinese and English shall enclosed with the notarized translated version in Chinese or English. Graduating students can provide pre-graduation Certificate. After admission, the original graduation certificate or notarized copy should be submitted. * 4. Non-criminal record certificate. * 5. A Self-introduction Video -Please speak in English or Chinese. -The video should be at least 2 minutes long, in MP4 format, and less than 7 MB. -Include a brief self-introduction, your study plan after enrollment, reasons for applying to this program and university in China, and your plans after graduation. -You may also highlight your language ability, interests, confidence, and motivation. * 6. Financial support certificate -Download the template, print it, fill it and ask your financial guarantor to sign and send scan copy . -It has to be filled in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . 7. Study Certificate in China -If you ever study in China, download the form, print it and ask your previous university in China to issue it with Study Certificate and Evaluation(attendance and performance). You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. Letter of commitment -Download the specific template required by the university from CUCAS. -Fill it on computer, print it, sign, and provide a scanned copy of the signed document. -The document must be in English or Chinese. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. All the visa pages in passport * 10. Photocopy of passport and all the visa pages. * 11. ID photo White background, 35mm×45mm in size. * 12. High School Academic Transcript The documents in other language except Chinese and English shall enclosed with the notarized translated version in Chinese or English. * 13. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
